parameters.content:
## Airtable contacts → ChatGPT company briefs → Google Docs → Slack (daily 7:00 AM)

**Setup (once):** edit the **CONFIG** node (Airtable base ID, Slack channel ID), select credentials on the 7 orange-warning HTTP nodes, invite the Slack bot to the channel.

**▶ Seed Contacts (manual)** — creates the Airtable table/fields if missing and inserts random contacts.
**⏰ Daily 7:00 AM** — reads every contact, groups by company, asks ChatGPT for a brief, creates one Google Doc per company, posts a digest with links to Slack.

Timezone = workflow Settings → Timezone (default Asia/Kolkata). Activate the workflow (toggle top-right) for the 7 AM schedule to run.
